steps.label: Training archives on Drive with publisher SHA-256
Frozen model evaluated once on test
Raw-video pose path matches training features

class_imbalance_note: touch has only ~60 usable positive training clips; its AP will be weak and have wide uncertainty.

blockers: COCO-17 pose models do not output left_hand, right_hand; RetailAction take/put/touch features rely on them.

Supplied coordinates are quantised to a 1/64 grid with max 0.9375: heatmap-cell coordinates inside the 600x600 shopper crop, not full-frame pixels. Extracted poses need the same crop and normalisation before features can match.
Supplied joint scores exceed 1.0 (raw heatmap peaks); Keypoint R-CNN scores are unbounded logits. Confidence channels are not comparable without re-fitting.
Keypoint R-CNN costs 2080.8 ms per 600x600 frame on this CPU, above the 200 ms budget for 5 Hz analysis of one person.
required_before_enabling: Choose a pose model with hand/wrist joints (e.g. a whole-body or 26-joint model) or retrain RetailAction on the COCO-17 subset plus derived neck/waist.
Re-express both supplied and extracted joints in person-box-normalised coordinates; use validity masks instead of raw confidences.
Run the chosen extractor on RetailAction's own videos and measure agreement with the supplied poses (PCK) before trusting transfer.
Retrain with the shared schema, then evaluate on held-out staged recordings from the target camera.

next_action: Wait for train.tar upload to finish, then run notebooks/Shop_RetailAction_T4.ipynb on a Colab T4 (pilot first).
